title: Egypt's Landmarks, 'ck' & Punctuation

scenes.t: {name} reads about Laila. Laila visited the Cairo Tower with her family.
They took pictures and saw the whole city.
Next, they explored the great Pyramids of Giza. Laila loved the camels!
At the Alexandria Library, she read fun books. It was the best holiday she ever had!
'ck' makes the /k/ sound at the end of a word: duck, sock, back, neck, truck.
We use a capital letter at the beginning of a sentence, a period (.) at the end, and a question mark (?) at the end of a question.

items.a: Built a long time ago in Egypt.
At the start of a sentence.
At the end of a sentence.
At the end of a question.

activities.title: Memory Game

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 50–54
